title: ?author= filter is exact-match only
evidence: app.py:176 uses `WHERE author = ?` (exact equality), not a substring/case-insensitive match
suggestion: Spec only asks for an author filter; exact match satisfies it. A LIKE match would be friendlier but is beyond spec.
